name: AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler
description:
AdaptlyPost is a social media scheduler. Create, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky from one account, then see how they performed.

From Claude you can: list your connected accounts, create a post for one or many platforms with a shared or per-platform caption, publish now, schedule it for later in your timezone or save it as a draft, bulk-schedule a week of posts in one request, attach images and video from a public URL or get an upload link for files on your phone or laptop, edit or delete scheduled posts, publish a draft, check per-platform publish results and retry the platforms that failed. Eighteen tools in total.

You can also pull views, likes, comments, shares, followers and engagement rate for any date window in the last 180 days, compared with the previous window. Get it as a daily, weekly or monthly timeseries, split per platform, or per post sorted by any metric. Analytics cover Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky and YouTube.

Platform rules are handled for you: per-platform captions, TikTok privacy settings, YouTube titles, Pinterest boards and scheduling times.

Sign in with your AdaptlyPost account. You need at least one connected social account to post.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adaptlypost.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler lists 18 MCP tools, including bulk_schedule_posts, create_post, delete_post, get_analytics_overview, get_analytics_sync_status, get_analytics_timeseries, get_platform_breakdown, get_post, get_upload_urls, list_accounts, list_post_analytics, and list_post_results.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdaptlyPost - social media scheduler is developed by AdaptlyPost. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
